overview_description.description:
Lucidya is an Enterprise B2B SaaS company that was founded in 2016 with a headquarter in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. In a few years, the company managed to scale its customers base from Saudi to more than 6 countries including leading brands in different industries like Telecoms, BFSI, Automotive, FMCG, Retail, and others

Thanks to its unique and proprietary AI & Arabic NLP technologies, Lucidya provides the most accurate analysis of interactions in the Arabic language making Lucidya the #1 tool in its category by users rating in MENA

product.name: AI Agent
product.description: An autonomous customer service platform that resolves routine cases, performs approved actions in enterprise systems, and supports Arabic and English interactions.

product.name: OmniServe
product.description: An omnichannel customer service workspace that consolidates customer messages and supports interaction management, routing, and agent performance tracking.

product.name: Social Listening
product.description: A real-time social intelligence product that monitors brand and competitor conversations, keywords, accounts, trends, engagement, and sentiment across social channels.

product.name: Profiles
product.description: A customer data platform that unifies behavioral, interaction, sentiment, demographic, interest, and purchase information into 360-degree customer records and segments.

product.name: Media Monitoring
product.description: A monitoring and analysis product for tracking brand, competitor, and topic mentions across online news, websites, blogs, and traditional media.

product.name: Survey
product.description: A multilingual customer feedback product for creating and distributing surveys, collecting responses, and analyzing sentiment and feedback in real time.
